description: Electric charge as topological winding number with fractional quarks from MED

results.winding_argument: SEC collapse singularities create point defects. Phase around defect has quantized winding number n ∈ Z.

fractional_charges_from_med.mechanism: MED nodes <= 3: a single winding n=1 shared among N nodes gives charge e/N per node
fractional_charges_from_med.1_of_3: q = e/3 → down-type quarks (d, s, b)
fractional_charges_from_med.3_of_3: q = e → charged leptons (e, μ, τ)

results.confinement: Fractional winding is not MED-closed → states with non-integer total winding cannot be isolated → quark confinement
results.conclusion: Charge quantization follows from topology (winding). Fractional charges are not postulated but emerge from MED's node limit applied to winding distribution.
